title: Controlled-time Atlas QA navigator
purpose: Provide a local dev/QA-only controlled-time navigator for Atlas human and automated testing so 1/3/7/21-day memory and transfer states can be exercised without real waiting, while preserving the canonical learner artifact and isolating simulated evidence.
invariants: The canonical learner source and normal Learn-it artifact remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
The navigator generates a separate dev-only controlled-time candidate and never republishes it to normal Pages.
The controlled-time candidate visibly displays TEMPS SIMULÉ — DONNÉES DE TEST whenever simulated time is active.
System time can be restored in one explicit action.
Simulated-time browser persistence is redirected to a dev-only namespace and cannot mutate normal learner storage.
The dev candidate never presents simulated evidence as real learner history.
Time controls cover exact ISO set plus +1d, +3d, +7d and +21d operations and deterministic reload behavior.
The implementation exercises the same Atlas clock contract/policy boundaries without changing memory intervals or transfer rules.
The tool remains local/offline and introduces no outbound network dependency.
No learner source, source manifest, production build, Pages workflow, Gate3, Gate4 or M4+ capability is modified.
requiredEvidence: Changed paths are exactly a subset of the five authorized dev-tool paths.
Canonical Learn-it build before/after dev candidate generation retains the exact expected normal artifact identity.
Generated controlled-time candidate is a distinct artifact with a visible simulation banner.
Normal and simulated storage namespaces are proven disjoint.
Reset removes only dev simulated-time state and restores system-time behavior.
1-day due boundary is exercised immediately without wall-clock waiting.
3-day, 7-day and 21-day reconfirmation boundaries are exercised deterministically.
Transfer availability remains governed by actual Atlas evidence rules under the simulated clock.
No outbound network call is required.
Product Pages workflow and learner source remain unchanged.
Exact DEV-WP-032 HEAD is frozen before QA-WP-019 final binding.
adversarialTests: Controlled candidate opens normal production IndexedDB/localStorage namespace.
Synthetic timestamp survives reset as ordinary learner evidence.
Banner absent while simulated time is active.
Clock can move to a non-canonical timestamp or non-integer delta.
Navigator changes Atlas interval policy instead of only current time.
Transfer becomes available without prerequisite evidence.
Generated candidate accidentally equals or overwrites the canonical artifact path.
Any learner source or production workflow path changes.
nonGoals: Changing Atlas memory or transfer policy.
Publishing simulated-time candidate to normal Pages.
independentReview: QA-WP-019 owns an independent contradictory oracle and never repairs DEV-WP-032 files.
Final QA binds to the exact frozen DEV-WP-032 HEAD.
Repository governance and PR scope validate the dev-tool branch.
No heavy accountable-human gate is required; optional manual smoke is non-blocking after independent QA PASS.
rollback: Drop the dev-tool branch/PR or delete the generated controlled-time candidate and dev-only storage. Canonical learner source, artifact and normal learner storage remain unchanged.
